# Travel Shizuoka | Local Travel Partners

> > Your local travel partner for Shizuoka tours, Mt. Fuji excursions, and Shimizu Port shore experiences with English-speaking guides.

Travel Shizuoka connects international visitors with authentic local experiences in Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. Specializing in private tours, bike adventures, and cruise ship shore excursions, they offer guided access to Mt. Fuji viewpoints, green tea farms, historic shrines, and scenic coastal areas through partnerships with Shizuoka University and native English-speaking guides.

## Key Topics

- Mt. Fuji tours and viewpoints
- Shimizu Port shore excursions
- Shizuoka Station departure tours
- Private guided tours with English speakers
- Bike tours through tea country
- Kunozan Toshogu Shrine (National Treasure)
- Nihondaira Plateau and Ropeway
- Miho Pine Tree Grove (World Heritage)
- Green tea farm experiences
- Lake Tanuki and Shiraito Falls
- Fujisan Hongu Sengen Shrine
- Local travel partnerships
- Cruise ship excursions
- Countryside cycling adventures

## Mt. Fuji & Private Tours

- [Private Mt.Fuji area tour from Shizuoka station (6.0 hours)](https://www.shizuoka-tour.com/tours-activities/mt_fuji_6hours-shizuoka): 6-hour private Mt. Fuji tour departing from Shizuoka station
- [Tours with Elliot (a native English speaking driver / guide)](https://www.shizuoka-tour.com/shimizu-port-shore-excursions/tours-with-elliot-a-native-english-speaking-driver-guide): Private tours with Elliot, native English-speaking driver/guide

## Bike Tours & Active Experiences

- [Hybrid Bike Tour to a Green Tea Farm](https://www.shizuoka-tour.com/tours-activities/bike-tour-to-a-green-tea-farm): Hybrid bike tour to green tea farm in Shizuoka with Mt. Fuji views
- [Mt.Fuji view & Countryside Bike Tour](https://www.shizuoka-tour.com/tours-activities/bike-tour-shizuoka): Guided countryside bike tour in Shizuoka with Mt. Fuji views

## Tourist Attractions & Landmarks

- [Kunozan Toshogu Shrine](https://www.shizuoka-tour.com/shimizu-port-shore-excursions/shimizu-port-2-5_hours_tour/kunozan-toshogu-shrine): National Treasure shrine on 2.5-hour Shimizu Port shore excursion
- [Nihondaira Plateau](https://www.shizuoka-tour.com/tours-activities/nihondaira-kunozan-toshogu-shrine-or-miho-pine-tree-grove/nihondaira-plateau): Scenic Nihondaira Plateau with tea farms and Mt. Fuji observatory
- [Miho Pine Tree Grove](https://www.shizuoka-tour.com/tours-activities/nihondaira-kunozan-toshogu-shrine-or-miho-pine-tree-grove/miho-pine-tree-grove): Mt. Fuji World Heritage site with pine grove and ocean views
- [Nihondaira Ropeway](https://www.shizuoka-tour.com/tours-activities/mt_fuji_6hours-shizuoka/nihondaira-ropeway): Ropeway connecting Nihondaira Plateau to Kunozan Toshogu Shrine
- [Sumpu Castle Park](https://www.shizuoka-tour.com/the-tourists-attractions/sumpu-castle-park): Historic Sumpu Castle Park with tea ceremony experiences in Shizuoka
- [Satta Pass](https://www.shizuoka-tour.com/the-tourists-attractions/satta-pass): Historic Satta Pass with famous Mt. Fuji painting viewpoint
- [Shimizu Fish Market 'Kashinoichi'](https://www.shizuoka-tour.com/the-tourists-attractions/shimizu-fish-market-kashinoichi): Local Shimizu fish market near JR Shimizu Station
- [Shimizu S-Pulse Dream Plaza](https://www.shizuoka-tour.com/the-tourists-attractions/shimizu-s-pulse-dream-plaza): Shopping & entertainment complex near Shimizu Port
